title: SpeechNexusSharedRuntimeStates
description: Single source of truth for observed model-runtime instance states shared by the admin and internal lifecycle contracts.

InstanceState.description: Observed lifecycle state. Only `stopped` proves that the process or container and its reserved resources are gone; `failed` and `quarantined` may still retain capacity.

ObservedInstanceState.description: Controller observation. `absent` means no matching instance generation was observed.
